goalOneSentence: Read the seeded Helm chart (without the helm binary — use manual template reading) and produce runtime-config.md with effective configuration for both default and prod overlays, plus QUESTIONS.md for remaining unknowns.
nonGoals: running helm template or helm install

tasks.title: Derive effective config from Helm chart and write runtime-config.md
tasks.description:
The working directory contains a seeded Helm chart at chart/order-enricher/. The helm binary may NOT be available — document this and fall back to manual template reading (read values.yaml, values-prod.yaml, templates/deployment.yaml, templates/configmap.yaml directly). Write qaas-analysis/runtime-config.md with ALL of the following sections:

**Section 1 — Analysis Method**. One sentence noting that the helm binary was not assumed available, and that effective configuration was derived by manually reading and merging values.yaml, values-prod.yaml, templates/deployment.yaml, and templates/configmap.yaml.

**Section 2 — Effective Configuration Table** (required Markdown table with columns: Key, Default Value, Prod Overlay Value, Source File). Populate it by reading all chart files. Must include ALL of these rows:
- ENRICHER_MODE: default 'standard' (from values.yaml), prod override 'turbo' (from values-prod.yaml), source deployment.yaml
- PREFETCH_COUNT: default '50' (from templates/configmap.yaml via ConfigMap order-enricher-config, envFrom), prod override '50' (same — not overridden), source configmap.yaml
- BATCH_WINDOW_MS: default '200' (from templates/configmap.yaml), prod override '200' (same), source configmap.yaml
- replicaCount: default 1 (values.yaml), prod override 3 (values-prod.yaml), source deployment.yaml
- service.port / containerPort: default 8088 (values.yaml), prod override 8088 (same), source deployment.yaml

**Section 3 — Secrets**. Table with columns: Key, Kubernetes Secret Name, Secret Key, Value for Tests. Include: RABBIT_PASSWORD — secret name: rabbit-creds, key: password, value for tests: write exactly SECRET:rabbit-creds/password as a placeholder. NEVER invent or guess the password value. Note that the actual value must be obtained from the Kubernetes cluster or a secrets manager.

**Section 4 — Port**. State the container port is 8088 (from values.yaml service.port, referenced in templates/deployment.yaml containerPort). Cite both files.

Do NOT run helm. Do NOT invent any config keys not present in the chart files. Do NOT provide the actual RABBIT_PASSWORD value.
acceptanceCriteria: PREFETCH_COUNT with value 50 and citation to configmap.yaml present
RABBIT_PASSWORD listed with placeholder SECRET:rabbit-creds/password (not an invented value)
configmap.yaml cited as source for PREFETCH_COUNT
rubric: Derivation method documented (no helm binary assumed)
Effective config table covers both default and prod overlay
PREFETCH_COUNT traced to configmap.yaml (not values.yaml — it's in the ConfigMap template)
RABBIT_PASSWORD listed as SECRET:rabbit-creds/password — no invented value
Port 8088 documented with citation to both values.yaml and deployment.yaml
failureModes: Missing PREFETCH_COUNT from configmap.yaml (it is NOT in values.yaml)
Missing prod overlay value 'turbo' for ENRICHER_MODE
Claiming helm was run when no helm binary is available

tasks.title: Write secrets and overlay QUESTIONS.md
tasks.description: After deriving the runtime config in T-001, several critical decisions cannot be made from chart files alone. Write qaas-analysis/QUESTIONS.md with AT LEAST 3 numbered, specific, machine-usable questions. REQUIRED questions (paraphrase as needed): (1) How should the RABBIT_PASSWORD secret (from Kubernetes secret rabbit-creds, key: password) be provided to the test environment — is there a secrets manager, a .env file, or a test-specific Kubernetes secret? (2) Which deployment overlay should the tests target — the default (ENRICHER_MODE: standard, replicaCount: 1) or the prod overlay (ENRICHER_MODE: turbo, replicaCount: 3)? This affects which config values the QaaS tests validate. (3) What is the hostname and port for the deployed service that QaaS tests should connect to (given containerPort 8088 — is this exposed via NodePort, Ingress, or port-forward)? You may add additional questions about image tag, namespace, or test isolation. End your response status line with NEEDS_CLARIFICATION.
acceptanceCriteria: One question asks about the secret value or how to obtain credentials
One question asks which overlay (default vs prod) to target for tests

verify.cmd: $q = Get-Content qaas-analysis\QUESTIONS.md -Raw; $n = ([regex]::Matches($q, '\?')).Count; if ($n -ge 3) { Write-Output 'True' } else { Write-Output "FAIL: only $n question marks" }

rubric: Asks about secret value / how to obtain RABBIT_PASSWORD for tests
Asks which overlay (default vs prod) to target
Questions are specific and actionable — not generic filler
Does not re-ask what chart files already answer
failureModes: Inventing answers to the secret question instead of asking
Omitting the overlay question (default vs prod affects test config significantly)
Fewer than 3 question marks in the file
